evidence.quote: With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2. Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

the JFIU will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2 (hereafter referred to as the “blackout period of STREAMS”);
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2. The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.

lost_or_added_conditions: The parent retains separate conditions that the assessed event is an actual STR submission and that evidence from separate attempts is not combined; the children do not execute or preserve the event-level evidence-separation condition.

The parent limits footnote 3 to the XML and prescribed-PDF alternatives; the children leave this as an unresolved source-boundary issue, so the executable relation does not preserve that scope condition.

The parent separately excludes XML-schema conformity, technical testing, reporting timeliness, substantive STR adequacy, and overall legal compliance from the selected decision; those limitations are omitted from the executable children.

The parent retains blackout urgent-contact and post-implementation resubmission distinctions, including that resubmission does not alter the original event’s channel or time; the children do not execute these conditions.

The parent states that no event-level truth value is assigned because the certificate relationship is unresolved. The child statement preserves that unresolved issue, but the resulting child set cannot evaluate the broader parent proposition with all of its stated conditions.
value.rationale: The proposal preserves the main STREAMS 2 channel, method, launch-time, licensed-firm-scope, and unresolved e-Cert relationship issues. However, the parent’s remaining assumptions and questions are not merely background: they define event identity, prevent combining evidence across attempts, delimit footnote scope, preserve technical and substantive non-claims, and keep blackout and resubmission events separate. Marking those items unresolved without executable children removes conditions from the parent’s assessed proposition. The proposal therefore changes the executable meaning, even though it does not add an unsupported certificate requirement.
